description: Season-peak stage 2 (2026-10-11): sampled A-family MLPs forecasting weeks 1-36 (to the end of the season) from finalized flu admission and ED histories, with and without historical ILI pretraining (pre-August-2022 state ILI rescaled to flu units) and neighbouring-state exchange. Problem us-flu-long-horizon: leave-one-season-out 2023-24/2024-25/2025-26, finalized inputs and labels. Fold models are turned into FluSight peak forecasts by `chromantis.seasonal` (model=trajectory) and scored on problems/us-flu-season-peak.json.
